entities.name: Islamist insurgency in Mozambique
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary:
The Islamist insurgency in Mozambique was a pivotal event in the country's history, marked by the emergence of violent extremism in the Cabo Delgado Province. 

The insurgency began in 2017, with the first reports of militant attacks on government targets. 

The conflict escalated rapidly, with the militants claiming to be fighting for the establishment of an Islamic state in the region. 

The Mozambican government responded with military force, but the insurgency continued to spread, causing widespread destruction and displacement of civilians. 

The international community has been drawn into the conflict, with various countries providing military and humanitarian assistance to the government. 

The legacy of the insurgency will be felt for generations to come, as Mozambique struggles to rebuild and reconcile with its troubled past.

The insurgency has left a trail of death and destruction in its wake, with over 3,000 people killed and thousands more displaced. As one local resident put it, "The war has changed our lives forever, we can never go back to the way things were before."
